title: A Real-Time Magnetic Device Prototype for Temporary Management of Paralytic Lagophthalmos
brief_summary: To develop a real-time wearable device based on the principle of magnetic force for temporary management of lagophthalmos, and evaluate its efficacy and safety, including synchronous blinks and eye closure, blurred vision, foreign body sensation over cornea or eyeball, burning or hot sensation over facial skin, and erythema or pruritus over eyelid, by performing a human trial on patients with lagophthalmos.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with unilateral lagophthalmos; they are capable of understanding and complying with protocol requirements
* Aged 18 years old or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* Upper eyelid scar, contracture, fibrosis, and atrophy due to previous surgical intervention(s)
* Patients with psychiatric (or mental) disorders; they are unable to cooperate or follow the study procedure
* Children younger than 18 years of age
